card.name: Comma after severe in suicidality warning
card.fires_on: The comma right after "severe" in the antidepressant warning about symptoms that are "severe, abrupt in onset, or were not part" of the patient's presentation. It fires on this one repeated sentence.

modes.label: Comma in warning list
modes.description: The comma after "severe" in a list of worrying features of emergent suicidality symptoms.
modes.example: especially if these symptoms are severe<<,>> abrupt in onset, or were not part

card.writes: The promoted tokens (mostly Chinese words for "enter" and " into") have no clear link to this text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on one comma in the standard antidepressant warning about severe, abrupt-onset suicidal symptoms.
